purpose: Gate for enabling the strategy advisor in Race Center live mode.

development_race.note: 2026 US GP capture used to build and tune the live accumulator (45 s stint-feed hold); in-sample, cannot qualify live mode.

qualification.races: Next untouched live races recorded with `python -m services.live.advisor_shadow watch` from before lights out; no code or threshold change after recording starts.
qualification.on_pass: Enable advisor/ensemble engines in Race Center live mode (remove the replay-only hold).
qualification.on_fail: Keep live mode held; diagnose on that race, then require two further untouched races.
